🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Market shows mixed leadership with Industrials/Energy/Real Estate posting multiple ABOVE TREND names while large Tech and parts of Financials are weak; Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 from 3 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate leads: AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +10.92%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +22.09%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -5.90%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND. Technology soft overall: ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -9.48%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed-to-weak: WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -5.08% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, MO (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors represented). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -9.48%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Software names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND. Watch AMZN in TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -3.34% | 1M: +7.44%) — a tactical divergence rather than confirmation of a new trend.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak with dispersion: NVDA (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +4.79%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND vs ADBE (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -14.88%) BELOW TREND and CRM (1W: -12.63% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND; Sector 1W: -2.14% (19 stocks) — Sector Weakness.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed with idiosyncratic winners and bank stress: BLK (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND vs WFC (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND; Sector 1W: -1.25% (20 stocks) — Internal Rotation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Patchy leadership: JNJ (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +4.47%) ABOVE TREND while ISRG (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -3.53%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -1.51%) BELOW TREND; Sector 1W: -0.93% (15 stocks) — Internal Rotation with idiosyncratic catalysts.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain selectivity in a NEUTRAL regime: favor positions showing confirmed ABOVE TREND strength in Industrials, Energy and Real Estate (e.g., LMT, CVX, AMT) and reduce exposure to the weakest software/communication names (e.g., INTU, CRM, NOW). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; prioritize earnings/sector-confirmed names over momentum-only plays.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -10.22% | 1M: -18.51%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -15.71% | 1M: -18.38%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.89% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +3.43%) and Real Estate (1W: +4.41%) given multiple ABOVE TREND leaders. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.14%) and Communication (1W: -3.79%) where damage is concentrated and could bleed into broader sentiment.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch continuation of 1M positive momentum as trigger signals: NVDA staying ABOVE TREND with expanding 1W strength would confirm tech rebound, AAPL (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.95%) BELOW TREND reclaiming 1M gains would signal repair, CVX holding ABOVE TREND and following bullish news would endorse Energy leadership.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CVX (+55): Chevron approves Leviathan expansion — CVX (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. JNJ not in sentiment list but showing strength; focus remains on CVX as a sentiment-confirmed leader.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CCI (-50): JPM downgrades PT yet CCI (1W: +8.61% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price (distribution risk). AMT (-45): PT cut vs AMT (1W: +8.94% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment divergence to monitor. MA (-45): regulatory headwinds and MA (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +10.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.58% | 1M: +26.34%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +13.29%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: concentrated Tech/software weakness (INTU, CRM, ADBE, NOW BELOW TREND) and sentiment divergences on AMT/CCI that could indicate distribution in select leaders.
